callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string representing an existing filesystem directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's codegraph index, or None if the index is unavailable or cannot be opened.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: Called on a valid CodeGraphExtractor instance. language is a registered language key. proj_dir is the project root directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping absolute filesystem paths (str) to lists of (function_name: str, body_text: str) tuples for all source files of the given language found in proj_dir and its subdirectories.
